episodes.synopsis: AR Team is trapped in enemy territory, and must break an encirclement to deliver valuable data back to base. But the enemy numbers are vast, and there's only a few of them…
episodes.title: THE SEED

episodes.synopsis: A new commander arrives at the forward base, and is quickly sent into battle. But a high-priority mission comes in before she even has a chance to get her feet wet.
episodes.title: WAKE UP

episodes.synopsis: M4A1 is trapped behind enemy lines with a deadly Sangvis Executioner after her. But even with Griffin T-Doll teams nearby, she's still reluctant to turn to them for help...
episodes.title: THE ECHO

episodes.synopsis: The mission to recover the other missing members of AR Team begins. They recover SOPII, but she quickly clashes with her new commander.
episodes.title: SILENCE 01

episodes.synopsis: A tense standoff during the attempt to rescue AR15 is interrupted when the Sangvis troops go out of control and start shooting each other.
episodes.title: SILENCE 02

episodes.synopsis: M4A1 continues her search for M16. But the members of 404 are after her as well, and they don't have good intentions…
episodes.title: THE MESSAGE 01

episodes.synopsis: AR Team tracks down Intruder, the Sangvis T-Doll commander. But Intruder is a commander-type, and has more than a few tricks up her sleeve…
episodes.title: THE MESSAGE 02

episodes.synopsis: Griffin's commanders are summoned to an emergency meeting at a secret HQ after the discovery of a piece of secret Sangvis data.
episodes.title: THE KINDLING 01

episodes.synopsis: AR Team goes on the hunt for Destroyer, the Ringleader behind the attack on the secret HQ. But something's wrong with AR15…
episodes.title: THE KINDLING 02

episodes.synopsis: AR15 is now a fugitive, hunted by both Griffin and Sangvis. The rest of AR Team wants to hunt for her, but Griffin has other plans for them.
episodes.title: THE KINDLING 03

episodes.synopsis: Squad Negev is assigned to help find the missing AR15. But they're cut off by Sangvis and trapped.
episodes.title: COMET 01

episodes.synopsis: As the Sangvis Mastermind throws hordes of T-Dolls at Griffin in an attempt to capture M4A1, AR15 prepares herself to make one last sacrifice for her friends.
episodes.title: COMET 02
